scope: Targeted manual reference review of Parque Santander / Carrera 4 / Calle 7; computational checks across the existing export. Not a citywide street-by-street or cadastral survey.
license: ODbL-1.0 for copied/derived map geometry; original qualitative notes and model parameters CC0-1.0; no Google or institutional imagery redistributed

sources.note: Dates are download/latest element edit, not survey dates.

sources.title: Overture Maps Buildings 2026-08-19.0
sources.note: Release date does not date underlying imagery.

sources.title: Google Maps: vista pública enlazada por el usuario
sources.note: Inspected one rendered panorama in headful Chrome. Selected POI is Parqueadero el Príncipe; it is not the camera or the courthouse.

sources.title: Captura de Street View aportada por el usuario: 691 Cra. 4
sources.note: Cream lower courthouse wing has three visible levels, ribbon windows, masonry plinth and a paved forecourt. Upper complex is partly cropped/occluded. Capture is not stored in the repository.

sources.title: Consejo Seccional de la Judicatura del Huila
Tribunal Superior de Neiva, ubicación institucional
sources.fact: Institution lists Piso 10, Oficina 10-09 at Carrera 4 #6-99.
sources.note: Confirms a tenth-floor designation in the complex; it supplies no measured exterior height, tower footprint or date of architectural survey.

sources.title: Hotel Neiva Plaza, sitio oficial
sources.fact: Calle 7 #4-62. Photograph shows a lower articulated cream/orange hotel with balconies and terraces.

sources.title: Alcaldía de Neiva: recuperación de la fuente del Parque Santander
sources.fact: Fountain with an irregular mosaic-lined basin; brick/paver edges, paved walking areas and dense tree canopy.
sources.note: Publication date is not established camera capture date.

sources.title: Alcaldía de Neiva: conmemoración de los 413 años
sources.fact: Identifies Templo Colonial and Parque Santander as distinct venues.

sources.title: SITYC Huila, inventario turístico de Neiva, ficha del Templo Colonial
sources.fact: Frontal photo shows a lateral stepped clock tower, pyramidal cap, arched portal and low curved main facade.
sources.note: Inventory date is not a verified image capture date. The tower is to the right of an observer facing the entrance from the park.

sources.title: Gobernación del Huila, Ruta de Arquitectura y Arte Religioso
sources.fact: Describes stepped lateral bell tower, curved fronton, round oculus, buttressed rectangular nave and clay tile roof.
sources.note: Its phrase left side of the nave is not a viewer-facing-left instruction; the frontal inventory photograph is used for side orientation.

buildingOverrides.name: Palacio de Justicia Rodrigo Lara Bonilla
buildingOverrides.reason: Render the visually referenced low wing at an interpreted 10.5 m. The institutional tenth-floor designation is retained as evidence of a taller complex, but no unverified tower prism is generated without a separate footprint.

buildingOverrides.name: Hotel Neiva Plaza
buildingOverrides.reason: OSM height=40 and building:levels=3 conflict with each other and with the owner photograph. 19.8 m approximates six visible levels and roof elements; it is not a measurement.

buildingOverrides.name: Templo Colonial
buildingOverrides.reason: A distinct original model follows the official inventory photograph: lateral clock tower, curved fronton, arched portal, oculus and buttresses. Total 14.71 m is interpreted on the OSM footprint, not a measured height.

excludedBuildings.reason: Suppress the generic enclosed residential extrusion inside the observed paved public park. ML footprint alone does not establish an enclosed habitable building or a 5.8 m obstruction; preserve source data for review.

reviewLimitations: One linked Google panorama rendered and was inspected manually. A second navigation resolved 691 Cra. 4 and its camera location but failed to render; architectural observation there relies on the user supplied screenshot.
Google Street View images examined are dated August 2024, although they were consulted in September 2026.
Institutional and owner photos have no independently established capture dates.
No dimensions, roof survey, heights or footprint relocation were extracted from Google imagery. Open-map footprints remain unchanged.
No mass Street View capture, no panoramic imagery stored in the repository, no claim that the full city was manually verified.
